name: Disco Hi-Tec (Singapore) Pte Ltd.
capabilities: Fully Automatic Grinder/Polisher for ultra thin wafers
Stealth Dicing laser saw for dry dicing process
summary: Disco Hi-Tec (Singapore) Pte Ltd. is a leading provider of precision machinery and diamond products for the semiconductor industry, specializing in cutting, grinding, and polishing technologies. They offer advanced solutions such as DBG systems, fully automatic grinders/polishers, and stealth dicing laser saws, catering to the needs of thin wafer processing and advanced packaging.
